summary:
# changelog-helper

Keeps CHANGELOG.md up to date from recent commits.

## What it will do
- Read commits since the last release
- Write a short summary of each change
- Add the summary to CHANGELOG.md

## What it needs
- git on this computer
- No keys, no internet

## How you'll know it works
- Coppice runs a test after it's built

## Where it goes
just this computer
